body:
## Pensieve 0.6.2

### Fixed
- **A to-do whose page you deleted** can get a new page again. Before, its old link stayed and led to a missing page.
- **A project's page list** could show as empty even though its pages were there (search still found them).
- **Back from a page** goes to that page's own project, not to a project you had open before. Each project still reopens where you left it.

### Download

| Your system | File |
|---|---|
| Windows 10 / 11 | **Pensieve-Setup-0.6.2.exe** |
| Mac with Apple Silicon | **Pensieve-0.6.2-mac-arm64.zip** |
| Mac with Intel | **Pensieve-0.6.2-mac-x64.zip** |
| Linux (64-bit) | **Pensieve-0.6.2-linux-x86_64.AppImage** or **Pensieve-0.6.2-linux-amd64.deb** |
| Android 8+ (HarmonyOS via 卓易通) | **Pensieve-0.6.2-android.apk** |
| iPhone / iPad (iOS 15+) | **Pensieve-0.6.2-ios-unsigned.ipa** — install with Sideloadly or AltStore ([how](https://photonghost308.github.io/pensieve-app/#ios-install)) |

Already using Pensieve? It updates itself (Settings → General → Updates). Your notes stay as they are.
name: Pensieve 0.6.2
